# Scan AML

> Scan AML helps users review Bitcoin and Ethereum wallet risk before a transaction through an address input, a 0–100 score, and a category breakdown.

## Pages
- [Scan AML](https://insert_url/): Address checker, risk score guide, fees, wallet safety, and frequently asked questions.
- [Address workspace](https://insert_url/dashboard/): Enter an address and review the result.

## Input and report
- Networks: Bitcoin mainnet and Ethereum.
- Input: One public wallet address and the selected network.
- Score categories: Direct exposure, up to 50 points; indirect exposure, up to 30 points; activity patterns, up to 20 points.
- Review bands: 0–24 lower priority, 25–59 closer review, 60–100 high priority.
- The score expresses review priority rather than the probability of criminal activity.
- The page uses a deterministic client-side address-to-score calculation.
- Price for the on-page address check: $0. Blockchain gas used: 0.
- The latest address and report are stored in sessionStorage for the current tab session. Clearing the address removes that record.
- The address checker accepts public addresses. Private keys, seed phrases, and passwords stay private.
